name: Figure-Four Stretch

instructions.description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh just above the knee to make a figure-four shape.
Lift the uncrossed leg and hold behind the thigh if you want a stronger stretch.
Breathe steadily, then switch sides after lowering both feet.

performanceMetrics.notes: Hold at a gentle stretch intensity in the buttock region.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Cross the ankle over the thigh while seated and hinge forward slightly.

commentsNotes: Keep the crossed foot active to reduce knee strain.
Do not pull aggressively on the lower leg.
